title: Dragon King
text: “Huh…?”
Flame Floor X is blown away by the impact, and the airship begins to shatter.
“W-what on earth is going on!? Ugh… Everyone! Hurry up and evacuate!”

Inside the collapsing airship, following Father’s orders, Yuki-chan and the others transform into their Filolial forms, carry everyone on their backs, and rush to safety. Everyone’s safety comes before mine. Soon, everyone had evacuated, and my Father reached out his hand to me.
“Hurry! Motoyasu-kun, too!”
“I know!”

Like a rising dragon, Takt’s dragon soared into the sky… creating a rain cloud and hiding itself within it. The way it looked at that moment… to me, it resembled the Dragon King I’d seen in a video game.
“What just happened?”
After the evacuation was complete, we landed near the other airship that had been left behind and looked up at the sky.
“W-what!? What happened to Lord Takt and the others?!”
The airship’s crew members pressed us with urgent questions. Father glared at them coldly.
“Two of the Four Holy Heroes saw through your conspiracy and crushed it.”
The Queen arrived then, her hand resting on a crew member’s back, ready to cast Magic at any moment. Also present were the representative from Siltvelt, my Finacée, and Sakura-chan.
“W-What nonsense! Lord Takt defeated!? Give me a break—”

Just then, a shadow appeared and killed one of the crew members with a dagger as a warning. I see—the Queen and the people of Siltvelt had sent out a shadow. In other words, the shadow must have witnessed the moment we were attacked by Takt.
“Queen, and you of Siltvelt. The Whip Hero… no, Takt, who pretends to be a hero, has attacked us, just as the Shield Hero and the Spear Hero said he would.”

It seems this shadow isn’t the pig I saw before, but a man. The shadow is explaining what has happened so far. It told everything without holding anything back: that Takt had attacked; that four Seven Star Weapons had flown out of Takt’s dead body; and that the dying Dragon Emperor, one of Takt’s subordinates, had grown gigantic and caused the airship to collapse.
“It’s foolish to show your true colors just because things didn’t go as planned…”
“Eek!?”
The crew began to cower.
“Naofumi, I’ve got the enemies over here under control.”
“I suppose they were trying to keep the scene of the ‘Hero Killer’ from being seen, thinking about the future… but that’s not the point.”
“What… on earth happened?”

Rain began to fall sporadically from the sky. But at the sight of that rain, everyone in the town below Melromarc’s castle let out cries of shock. With a sizzle… smoke began to rise from the spots where the rain hit.
A silhouette reminiscent of a dragon flickered in and out of view through a gap in the clouds. And then the rain began to pour down.
“Gyaaaaaaaah!”

The soldiers of Siltvelt, drenched by the rain, rolled around on the ground, billowing smoke. The areas where the falling rain struck were dissolving, creating a sight too gruesome to behold. T-This is…!
“Acid rain!?”
“A Magic spell that makes strong acid rain fall… right?”
“Yes. But I’ve never seen Acid Rain this powerful before.”
“That’s a problem in itself, but Motoyasu, did you see it too?”
“Yes, I saw it.”
It’s the third blue hourglass appearing in my field of vision. Judging by the numbers and that form, there’s no doubt about it—it’s the Dragon King.
“That’s the Dragon King… the last of the Four Spirits.”
“No way… I’d heard about the Four Spirits from Motoyasu, but are you saying that the dragon in Takt broke the seal without thinking of the consequences!?”

If I recall correctly, the Dragon King was described as being “sealed within the Dragon Emperor,” with its exact location unknown. I remember confusing my Father with game knowledge that was different from Ren’s and Itsuki’s.
However, I had intended to finish off the Dragon along with Takt, and neither in the first world nor in the previous one did things end up like this. What was different, I wonder? I have no idea.
“Last time, we took out Takt first, but things didn’t turn out like this, did they?”
“According to Motoyasu, he didn’t use it last time… no, maybe he couldn’t?”
“I see. So it was something you’d recently acquired?”
“Or… perhaps there’s a proper way to break the seal on the Dragon King, and you did something necessary to skip that procedure.”

That’s possible. For the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix, there are ways to break the seal other than simply reviving naturally. It’s the kind of thing I, Ren, and Itsuki did. It wouldn’t be unnatural to assume the Dragon King had something like that as well. As I was pondering this, my Father muttered to himself, “What if… in the worst-case scenario, the remaining seal might break on its own?”
“What do you mean by that?”

“Assuming the Four Spirits are linked and power is being channeled to the other three, that would put a strain on the seal. In that state, Takt’s dragon might have been able to deliver the final blow on its own… or so I’m thinking.”
Well now, that’s not an impossible scenario. This is a crucial point. If we’re going to take down Takt, we must kill the dragon first—otherwise, we might end up breaking the seal on the Dragon King.
“Hurry and evacuate the citizens! Lord Iwatani and Lord Kitamura, please handle the Dragon King.”
“Got it! But…”

The queen hurriedly issues orders to the kingdom. It seems she and her Finacée are using Magic to create a water barrier to shield themselves from the rain. My Father stares at the dark clouds, his expression clouding with concern. Just then, the dragon’s roar echoes, and a multi-headed dragon plummets from the sky.
“Die! You’re Takt’s killer!”
“Whoa!”

All of the dragon’s heads unleashed their breath attacks at us. From the looks of it, the attack is like a highly compressed torrent. Father redeploys his Shooting Star Shield and blocks all of the dragon’s breath attacks.
“Gyaaaaaaaah!”

The Faubrey soldiers struck by the deflected breath are melting away. It seems to be a torrent of strong acid. Or rather, it has a lot of heads. One, two, three… It looks like it has nine heads in total. Is it a Hydra-type dragon?
“Are you telling me we still can’t break through?! More! Give me more of your power!”
Who is that dragon talking to? Anyway, we’d better take it down quickly! Those heads are getting in the way. Let’s finish it off cleanly and for good.
“Father, please cast some support magic!”
“Huh!? Oh, yeah. Got it. Zweite Aura X!”
Even though it’s called “Zweite,” it performs quite well when enhanced. And while its range is wide, it should be enough to boost the power of this skill, which otherwise lacks lethality.
“Aiming Lancer X!”
I’m going to lock onto every head and torso and blow them right through.
“Guhah!? Not yet—I cannot be defeated here! Give me more power to make them pay!”

Huh? It’s tough—it’s still alive even after being pierced by Aiming Lancer. The water that splattered is wriggling around like slime as it returns to its body, and the head has regenerated. What’s more, it’s grown another head.
“Take this!”
The dragon is firing at us… all at once, it’s unleashing that strange light breath that Rival used in the first world. I seem to recall Father telling me that it has a silencing effect.

Father is clutching his throat. It’s the Silence effect. I pulled a Silence-curing potion from my spear and drank it. But to inflict a status ailment on me—someone who’s even prepared for resistance—suggests the aftereffects are quite potent, don’t you think? Father also took a potion and responded immediately.
It seems this light breath has an effect even if you aren’t hit directly by it. Everyone nearby groans in frustration at being unable to speak. This is where my Magic comes into play.
“Al-Liberation Anti-Silence Flame X!”

It’s a fire-attribute area-of-effect silence cure Magic. Just to be safe, I’ll set it to high power. With that, I’ve finished healing everyone around me. Well, the Breath of Light itself seems pretty powerful, but to take down me or my Father, they’ll have to break through the Shooting Star Shield first. So, while it doesn’t seem possible to pierce Father’s Shooting Star Shield, the Faubrey soldiers nearby are in a total frenzy and fleeing.
“Air Strike Shield X! Second Shield X!”
He doesn’t even have to do this… but Father is shielding us to prevent the dragon’s attacks from hitting us. How kind of him.
